## Description

Please include a summary of the change, what issue is fixed, or what feature is added.

---

## 🚫 Pre-flight Security Checklist

Please verify each item before submitting your Pull Request:

- [ ] **No Secrets:** I have confirmed that no private API keys, client secrets, passwords, or token keys are committed.
- [ ] **No Provider Info:** I have confirmed that no private server URLs, portal domains, or playlist files are committed.
- [ ] **No Content:** I have verified that no copyrighted channels, streams, or media playlists are included.
- [ ] **Compilation Passes:** `flutter analyze lib/` returns 0 compiler errors or warnings.
- [ ] **Tests Pass:** `flutter test` completes successfully.
- [ ] **Responsive Test:** The UI changes have been verified to render correctly on Mobile, Android TV, or both (where applicable).

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Code layout polish or refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
